change-context-v1.description: Semantic completeness contract for an Issue or Feature that authorizes a repository change.

requiredSemantics.question: What is in and explicitly out of scope?
What repositories, artifacts, services, Issues or decisions are required or blocked?
What identity, permission boundary and source of truth authorize the work?
What created, start, target, completion or last-reviewed times matter?
What evidence makes the requirement complete?
What PR, artifact, deployment and runtime result implement it?
Where are changing observations and telemetry discussed?
Is this contemporaneous, migrated or historically inferred, and with what confidence?

rules: Projects may rename fields and use repository-specific types and statuses.
A semantic may be satisfied by any accepted binding; duplicate fields are not required.
Missing context is explicit rather than silently inferred.
Historical items record the represented time range and whether classification was inferred.
Raw telemetry and secrets never satisfy durable context.
